environment: Local LiquidJS rendering with explicit Shopify API fixtures; Chrome; not live Shopify verification

results.name: Responsive home, collection, product, quote and cart render without overflow or missing images
Automated WCAG A/AA checks on main storefront templates
Variant selection replaces SKU, price and URL; unavailable variant cannot be added
Cart drawer uses native checkout, Escape restores focus and repeated adds are serialized
Server cart errors are visible and do not announce success
Quote list persists, selects exact model and carries quantity into native contact form
Media thumbnails select a photograph without moving the product information
Mobile pricing action opens an exact-model enquiry without duplicating the saved quantity
Mobile purchase bar adds the selected model and restores focus after closing the bag
Homepage model search uses Shopify search and pricing requests recover when browser storage is blocked
Blocked storage preserves a newly requested model alongside the existing project list
Homepage loads only shared controls; project code loads when a pricing action is used
Confirmed add unlocks both purchase controls without a secondary cart request and keeps checkout visible
Failed product enhancement retains the native model selector and purchase submission
No JavaScript: variant selection, purchase, filters and enquiry remain native forms
Arabic locale changes chrome and direction without overflow
